U_0x0024A7: cART-1 stands for "ADVANCED REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TEST TYPE-1," a new <Personal Trooper> built under the RXR Project, the next-generation R Series program within the <Laios Plan> to improve the reliability and stability of <EOT>. Built experimentally from R-1 and Huckebein Mk-III data (a prototype of a prototype, hence its prototype colors, not the R-1's tricolor). U_0x002847: RART-1's flight form (Flyer Mode). It can deploy a Telekinetic Field and ram enemies.
U_0x00291E: A thorough rebuild of Alt Eisen, which lost all four limbs fighting the Soulgain flown by Axel Almar of the <Shadow Mirror>. Dr. Marion Radom built it, loosely based on the views of pilot Kyosuke Nanbu. It carries spare Weiss Ritter parts and the Revolving Bunker, once rejected for ruining its balance; all other arms were enlarged. Its <Tesla Drive> only adjusts balance and boosts its charge, so it cannot fly for long. Alt Eisen Risse thus has firepower and rushing power unheard of in a <Personal Trooper>, but handles even worse than Alt Eisen. "Risse" is German for "giant."
U_0x002D7A: Weiss Ritter's powered-up form, transfigured by an unknown technology; over 60% of it defies analysis. Its Howling Launcher seems to be an altered Oxtongue Launcher. It can deploy a strong <Energy Field> and strike with thought waves.
